The four propositions in this Noetherian-local subsection are consequences of faithful flatness of completion, descent of flatness and finite projectivity, universal injectivity, and completion commuting with finite quotients.
Completion is faithfully flat, hence A to completed(A) is universally injective and completed(A) is flat. Applying the flat-domain lemma to its cokernel makes completed(A)/A flat.

B to completed(B) is faithfully flat and completed(B)=completed(A) is flat over A, so flatness descends to B over A. A to completed(B) is universally injective, hence permanence makes A to B universally injective; the flat-domain lemma then makes B/A flat.

Universal injectivity of A to B survives tensoring with A/a, giving A/a into B/aB. Completion-tensor identifies the two quotient completions with completed(A)/a completed(A) and completed(B)/a completed(B); the original completion isomorphism descends to these quotients. Proposition 28's live-label derivation then applies.

The Proposition 28 hypotheses make A to A' flat; because it is local, it is faithfully flat. Finite projectivity descends, and a finite projective module over a local ring is finite free. Base change preserves and detects the stated rank n.
